quizBanner.title: Can you spot the fake?
quizBanner.subtitle: Take our 3-question media literacy quiz and earn a TrustLab badge.

quiz.title: Spot the Fake
quiz.subtitle: Three quick rounds to sharpen your eye for AI-generated photos and manipulated headlines.
quiz.badgeGoldDesc: Perfect score — you caught every fake.
quiz.badgeSilverDesc: Sharp eye — a couple of fakes slipped through.
quiz.badgeBronzeDesc: Good start. Practice makes perfect — try again.
quiz.q1prompt: Real footage like these two photos often gets reshared with a false caption — an old photo passed off as something that "just happened" somewhere else. What's the most reliable way to check?
quiz.q1optionA: Trust it if the post has a lot of shares and comments
quiz.q1optionB: Reverse-image-search the photo to find its original publish date and source
quiz.q1explanation: A reverse image search (Google Images, TinEye) surfaces a photo's earliest known appearance — revealing its real date, location, and source. That's the most reliable way to catch a real photo being recycled with a false caption; share counts say nothing about accuracy.
quiz.q2prompt: Which headline is more likely to be disinformation?
quiz.q2optionA: "Government confirms new bridge to open in September, city council says"
quiz.q2optionB: "THEY DON'T WANT YOU TO KNOW: Border 'secretly' reopened, sources claim"
quiz.q2explanation: Option B uses classic manipulation markers — ALL CAPS urgency, vague 'sources,' and a conspiratorial framing — instead of a named, checkable source.
quiz.q3prompt: You see a viral post with no cited source. What's the most reliable next step?
quiz.q3optionA: Check the share count — if thousands shared it, it's probably true
quiz.q3optionB: Cross-check the claim against two or more independent, credible outlets
quiz.q3explanation: Popularity isn't proof. Cross-referencing independent, credible sources is the single most reliable habit in media literacy.

extension.title: TrustLab Extension
extension.subtitle: Real-time fake-post detection, right inside Facebook and Telegram.
extension.description: Our browser extension scans posts as you scroll and overlays a simple badge: green for verified, red for flagged. No extra clicks, no leaving the feed.
extension.feature1Desc: Checks posts against our verified claims database as you browse.
extension.feature2Desc: A clear visual indicator appears directly on Facebook and Telegram posts.
extension.feature3Desc: Tap a badge to see the full fact-check and sources.
extension.modalBody: The extension is currently in private beta for Chrome and Firefox. Leave your email on the Submit page or follow our channels to get notified at launch.

bot.title: Ask TrustLabBot
bot.subtitle: Instant verification over WhatsApp and Telegram — built for rural and low-bandwidth areas.
bot.description: Forward a suspicious text, photo, or voice message to @TrustLabBot and get a verdict back in minutes — no app install or extra data plan required beyond messaging.
bot.step1Desc: Send the text, screenshot, or voice note directly to the bot.
bot.step2Desc: Our editors and database cross-check the claim against verified sources.
bot.step3Desc: Receive a clear reply: true, false, manipulative, or pending review.
